mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM psi_unit WHERE deleted = 0 AND unit_type IN ('CUSTOMER','BOTH')) AS customerTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM psi_unit WHERE deleted = 0 AND unit_type IN ('CUSTOMER','BOTH') AND create_time >= #{monthStart}) AS thisMonthCustomer, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eoms_repair_order WHERE del_flag = '0') AS orderTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eoms_repair_order WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = 'WAIT_SETTLEMENT') AS waitSettlement, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eoms_repair_order WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('WAIT_ACCEPT','ACCEPTED','PROCESSING')) AS waitRepair, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eoms_repair_order WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = 'WAIT_ACCEPT') AS waitAccept, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eoms_repair_order WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status IN ('ACCEPTED','PROCESSING')) AS processing, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eoms_repair_apply WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = 'WAIT') AS waitApply, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eoms_repair_order WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{monthStart}) AS thisMonthOrder, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM eoms_income WHERE del_flag = '0') AS totalIncome, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM eoms_income WHERE del_flag = '0' AND income_date >= #{monthStart}) AS monthIncome, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM psi_goods g WHERE g.deleted = 0 AND g.stock_lower IS NOT NULL AND g.stock_lower > 0 AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.remain_quantity), 0) FROM psi_stock_batch b WHERE b.goods_id = g.id AND b.deleted = 0) < g.stock_lower) AS stockAlert, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT goods_id) FROM psi_stock_batch WHERE deleted = 0 AND remain_quantity > 0) AS stockTotal FROM dual
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM eoms_repair_order WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{beginDate} AND create_time < #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT m.material_id AS materialId, COALESCE(g.goods_name, m.material_name, CONCAT('物料#', m.material_id)) AS name, COALESCE(g.goods_name, m.material_name, CONCAT('物料#', m.material_id)) AS materialName, g.goods_code AS materialNo, COALESCE(SUM(m.quantity), 0) AS `usage`, COALESCE(SUM(m.quantity), 0) AS quantity FROM eoms_repair_material m LEFT JOIN psi_goods g ON g.id = m.material_id AND g.deleted = 0 WHERE m.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY m.material_id, g.goods_name, m.material_name, g.goods_code ORDER BY `usage` DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM eoms_income WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{beginMonthStart} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM eoms_cost WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{beginMonthStart} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT CASE unit_nature WHEN 'ENTERPRISE' THEN '企业' WHEN 'PERSON' THEN '个人' ELSE IFNULL(unit_nature, '未分类') END AS type, CASE unit_nature WHEN 'ENTERPRISE' THEN '企业' WHEN 'PERSON' THEN '个人' ELSE IFNULL(unit_nature, '未分类') END AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM psi_unit WHERE deleted = 0 AND unit_type IN ('CUSTOMER','BOTH') GROUP BY unit_nature ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT o.engineer_id AS engineerId, COALESCE(u.nickname, CONCAT('工程师#', o.engineer_id)) AS engineerName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('FINISHED','CLOSED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount FROM eoms_repair_order o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.engineer_id WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.engineer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.engineer_id, u.nickname ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
